Subject: Request: vulnerability artifacts and pen-test summary for RFP HB-2026-133

Hi Mina,

As part of Harbor Bank's procurement evaluation for RFP HB-2026-133 we need a consolidated vulnerability-management package to complete our technical review. Can you please provide the following material by EOW (Friday):

- Executive pen-test summary (high-level findings, risk ratings, remediation status)
- Recent SAST and DAST scan summaries (last 12 months) and CSV/ZIP with raw findings where possible
- SBOM (component list) for the inference control plane and the hosted API surface (CSV preferred)
- Patch SLA commitments and a short description of your vulnerability triage process (who owns severity triage and timelines)
- Any third-party pentest vendor report redactions you can share and evidence of remediation verification (re-test notes)

We will treat all artifacts under the NDA you signed. If anything needs a controlled delivery (SFTP / secure link / Docusign acknowledgement) let me know.

Thanks,
Jared
Director, Vendor Security
Harbor Bank

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: HarborBank RFP - assemble VM artifacts (SAST/DAST, SBOM, pen-test)

Mina / Rishi — files uploaded to Drive (link below) and attached here as redacted packages. Short highlights for the exec summary and remediation status: 

Attachments included:
- pen-test-summary_2026-07-28.pdf [Attachment: 12 pages, redacted]
- sast-dast-results_2026-07.zip [Attachment: contains CSV exports; PII redacted]
- harborbank_sbom_202607-compact.csv [Attachment: compact SBOM export]

Executive summary highlights (for external-facing email):
- RedwoodSec performed black-box + authenticated testing; 8 total findings: 1 critical (OAuth misconfiguration, fixed), 3 high (two fixed, one mitigated by WAF rules), 4 medium (remediations scheduled and tracked).
- Critical finding was patched on Jul 20; re-test by RedwoodSec (Jul 26) validated remediation. Re-test notes included in the PDF (section 4).
- SAST showed three historical codepath issues (low-to-medium) with remediation completed and PR references included.
- DAST surface-level findings largely related to outdated library warnings; SBOM reference included to aid verification.
- No dependencies with known active exploit-level CVEs at time of test (see SBOM and vulnerability columns).

Rishi — draft SLA verbiage below (copied to this thread); edit as needed before Mina sends externally: 

Patch SLA (draft):
- Severity 1 (critical): initial ack within 2 business hours; remediation plan within 48 hours; target remediation 7 calendar days; mandatory re-test by third-party or internal security within 14 days.
- Severity 2 (high): ack within 4 business hours; remediation plan within 5 business days; target remediation 30 calendar days.
- Severity 3 (medium): ack within 1 business day; remediation plan within 10 business days; target remediation 90 days.
- Severity 4 (low): ack within 3 business days; scheduled per regular release cadence.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCDEF-harborbank-vm-pkg

Let me know if you want additional raw logs; we will need a controlled transfer for those.

— Stephanie
Head of Security Ops, Redwood Inference
